hook: Uppuguda colony says a metal unit sent *12* people to hospital
hook_b: Uppuguda colony says a metal unit sent *12* people to hospital
tldr: Residents of Hanuman Nagar in Uppuguda say an allegedly unpermitted metal-processing unit in their colony has spread fumes, metal dust and noise for nearly two months.

beats.what: About 30-35 families (200-250 people) are affected, residents say; they petitioned GHMC's Charminar zone in October.
beats.why: Residents allege the unit runs from an open plot without municipal permission or pollution clearance.
beats.care: GHMC's Charminar zonal commissioner says GHMC will act, but the Labour Department and Pollution Control Board also need to.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Residents have asked GHMC and TGPCB to inspect the site; the unit's side is not in the report.

qs: Who checks whether small units have pollution clearance?

facts.t: The residents' petition cites *five* police complaint IDs.

steps.e: Prajavani petition to GHMC Charminar zone

watch: Whether GHMC and TGPCB inspect the unit.

sources.name: Times of India
sources.title: Fumes, filth and noise fuel residents' fury in Uppuguda colony

fact: Uppuguda residents say fumes from a metal unit put *12* people in hospital
twist: Residents say they dialled 100 about *7-8 times* since September; the unit restarts after each halt.
